item.title: Introducing Modern Jewish Ethics
item.description: The following event will probably be of interest to the members of our Society. The Jewish Studies Colloquium at Brandeis University is sponsoring a workshop on a book in process Introducing Modern Jewish Ethics, 1970-Present with Journal of Jewish Ethics co-editors Jonathan Crane and Emily Filler, and SJE member Mira Wasserman. Full details on the flyer below.

item.title: Center for Jewish Ethics annual essay contest
item.description: This came across our desk and will probably be of interest to our members and their students. Call for submissions for the Center for Jewish Ethics annual essay contest to encourage fresh thinking on contemporary Jewish ethics. Established by Bruce Whizin, z”l, the Whizin Prize in Jewish Ethics is awarded for the best essay, research paper or curriculum addressing a contemporary ethical issue from a Jewish perspective. The prize includes an award of $1,800 and publication on the Center’s website

item.title: SJE Announces the Creation of Two New Awards
item.description: Dear SJE friends, We are thrilled to announce the creation of two awards that recognize the contributions and promise of our members. The Lifetime Achievement Award is a new and prestigious honor established to recognize individuals who have made extraordinary contributions to the field of Jewish Ethics. item.title: Serve on the Board of the SJE
item.description: The Board of Directors of the Society of Jewish Ethics acts on all matters concerning the Society, sets policy, and leads the organization.
